_comment: Qubix OS — the DankMaterialShell half of the Niri theme. Read by DMS as its
customThemeFile; /usr/bin/qubix-dms-theme points each user's settings at this path.
DMS watches the file, so a rebase that changes it reloads live — which is why the
path is in /usr and the per-user settings only hold a pointer.
Same palette as /etc/niri/qubix-theme.kdl: one hue, hsl(208, 24%, L), with lightness
doing all the work. error and warning are the deliberate exceptions.
Change one file, change the other. See docs/design-decisions.md DD-022, DD-025.
